name: Nan Shared Aggregate
essence: An empty quote turns the shared ledger total into NaN.

examples.summary: An empty quote turns the shared ledger total into NaN.
examples.mechanism: JavaScript zero divided by zero is NaN; holding a lock flag protects access but does not validate the value added to shared state.
examples.expected_behavior: total 100, with the empty quote rejected.

ingredients.suggests: An empty amount is divided by an empty unit count.
The module ledger is updated while the shared lock flag is held.
